create_Databag_add_vectors: create a Databag with a given dimension and add vectors to it for nearest neighbor lookup
create_Dataset_from_xy: create a Dataset from separate x and y arrays using the from_xy class method
find_nn_x_in_Dataset: find the k nearest neighbors of an input vector x in a Dataset using nn_x
find_nn_y_in_Dataset: find the k nearest neighbors of an output vector y in a Dataset using nn_y
create_BufferedDataset_with_buffer: create a BufferedDataset with a configurable buffer size to batch KDTree rebuilds when adding data
